name: Sparse Voxel Octree Representation
definition: A hierarchical data structure representing the scene as a sparse voxel octree to enable indirect illumination at geometry-independent cost with real-time frame rates.
summary: A Sparse Voxel Octree is a hierarchical data structure that represents 3D geometry by recursively decomposing space only where active voxels exist, eliminating empty regions and enabling efficient ray-traced rendering.
